run_3d_viewer: run the GLRenderer to load and display a 3D model file using OpenGL fixed-function pipeline
render_model_with_postprocess: render a 3D model file with postprocessing preset for maximum realtime quality
load_model_with_buffers: load a 3D model and prepare OpenGL vertex, normal, and triangle buffers for each mesh
cycle_cameras: cycle through embedded cameras in a 3D scene by pressing the c key during rendering
fit_scene_to_viewport: scale and center a 3D scene to fit the entire geometry within the OpenGL viewport
